title: ChipBlocks packages manifest
description: Single source of truth for physical chip packaging. Per ADR-005, this file is authored at repo root. Shuttles reference rows here via the `package` field. Day-one separation from shuttles.yaml is intentional: the anticipated v2 case is one shuttle offered in multiple package options (e.g. ChipBlocks Standard in QFN-32 for PCB-mount vs DIP-40 for hand-solder vs bare die).

kind.description: Physical packaging style. 'wrapper' is a mux/harness wrapper (eFabless Caravel); the others are real chip-carrier packages.

io_pins.description: Breakdown of pins by role (ui_in / uo_out / uio / control / power).

upstream.description: Upstream source for the package definition (e.g. eFabless Caravel repo).
